commit_message.description: Only when this job lets you write files: the commit message for what you wrote this turn, in the repository's style.

mode.description: What this issue needs: notes alone, a spec, or several issues (multi), suggested in sub_issues.

sub_issues.description: Only when the work is several changes that each merge on their own, or when Dr K asks for more: the sub-issues to suggest, in the order to do them. Dr K ticks the ones to file.

why.description: One line: what this part is, and why it is its own issue.
